alphaevolve_notebook_audit: Same constant C4 and same Hermite-polynomial x Gaussian family (formulation 1), but the class is enlarged: probabilist's Hermite basis and 'setting all alpha's beyond alpha7 to zero instead of alpha3'. The paper never uses the words 'upper bound' and once mislabels 0.3523 a 'lower bound', so direction rests on its own (down-arrow) convention; downgrade to UNCLEAR if the audit requires the 3-coefficient class to be held fixed. Regardless, formulation 2 (0.3216) already beats both, so the row's value is not the best known upper bound on C4 in any formulation.
